About.metaDesc: Meet Boulet Mushrooms: functional mushroom double extracts made in Barcelona from 100% organic fruiting bodies.
About.intro: At Boulet, we believe wellbeing is a balance between body and mind. Our mission is to reconnect people with the power of nature through functional mushroom extracts — grown with respect and processed with science.
About.processP1: We use a double-extraction method — hot water and alcohol — reinforced with ultrasonic-assisted extraction (UAE) to release all the mushroom’s bioactive compounds: polysaccharides, beta-glucans and triterpenes. The result is a complete extract, not a simple powder.
About.processP2: Extraction takes weeks. Not days. Patience is part of our formula — slowly extracted in Barcelona.
About.originP1: We select mushrooms from certified local farms, grown in controlled conditions without pesticides or heavy metals. We only use the fruiting body — the part with the highest density of active compounds.
About.originP2: No filler mycelium. No grains. No tricks.
About.g1Desc: Independent lab analysis for every production batch.
About.g2Desc: Sustainably cultivated. No pesticides or heavy metals.
About.g3Desc: If you’re not satisfied within 30 days, we refund your money — no questions asked.
About.g4Desc: No mycelium, no grains, no fillers. Maximum concentration of actives.
About.quote: Nature has answers that science is only beginning to understand.

Faq.metaDesc: Answers about functional mushrooms, safety, dosage, combinations and shipping from Boulet Mushrooms.
Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our products.
Faq.a1: They are mushrooms used for centuries in traditional medicine for health benefits beyond basic nutrition. They help the body adapt to stress and support balanced function.
Faq.a2: Yes. All our products use 100% organic mushroom fruiting bodies. We use a double-extraction method to capture beneficial compounds, and every batch is third-party tested for purity and potency.
Faq.a3: Effects vary by person and product. Some benefits, like Cordyceps energy, can be felt quickly. Others, like Lion’s Mane cognitive support, may take a few weeks of consistent use.
Faq.a4: Absolutely — we recommend it. Combining functional mushrooms (known as stacking) can amplify effects. For example, Lion’s Mane in the morning for focus and Reishi at night for calm.
Faq.a5: Functional mushrooms are generally well tolerated. As with any supplement, consult your doctor before starting — especially if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking medication.

lions-mane-tincture.name: Lion's Mane Double Extract 30ml
lions-mane-tincture.description: Boost your mental clarity and focus. Our Lion's Mane (Hericium erinaceus) tincture is ideal for work, study, and creativity.
lions-mane-tincture.habitat: Grows mainly on dead or dying hardwood trees such as oak, beech, and maple.
lions-mane-tincture.howToUse: Take 1 full dropper (1ml) once or twice daily. Can be mixed with your favorite beverage.

cordyceps-tincture.name: Cordyceps Double Extract 30ml
cordyceps-tincture.description: Increase your energy and physical endurance. Cordyceps (Cordyceps militaris) is the perfect ally for athletes and people with an active lifestyle.
cordyceps-tincture.habitat: Originally found at high altitudes in the Himalayas, now sustainably cultivated on organic substrates.
cordyceps-tincture.howToUse: Take 1 full dropper (1ml) in the morning or before physical activity.

reishi-tincture.name: Reishi Double Extract 30ml
reishi-tincture.description: Find your center and calm your mind. Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum), known as the 'mushroom of immortality', is an adaptogen that helps manage stress.
reishi-tincture.habitat: Grows at the base and stumps of deciduous trees, especially maple.
reishi-tincture.howToUse: Take 1 full dropper (1ml) in the afternoon or evening to help you relax.

chaga-tincture.name: Chaga Double Extract 30ml
chaga-tincture.description: Support your defenses with Chaga (Inonotus obliquus). Double extract of fruiting body rich in antioxidants.
chaga-tincture.habitat: Grows on birch trees in cold climates of the northern hemisphere.
chaga-tincture.howToUse: Take 1 full dropper (1ml) once or twice daily. Can be mixed with water, tea, or coffee.

tremella-tincture.name: Tremella Double Extract 30ml
tremella-tincture.description: Tremella (Tremella fuciformis) for skin hydration, elasticity, and immune support. 100% fruiting body double extract.
tremella-tincture.habitat: Grows on dead wood in subtropical climates of Asia.
tremella-tincture.howToUse: Take 1 full dropper (1ml) daily. Ideal in the morning or as part of your wellness routine.

3-product-bundle.name: Wellness Bundle
3-product-bundle.description: The most complete bundle. Includes Lion's Mane for focus, Cordyceps for energy, and Reishi for stress relief and rest.
3-product-bundle.howToUse: Take Cordyceps and Lion's Mane in the morning, and Reishi at night.
